description: This Java class defines a generic graph data structure with methods for adding nodes and edges, retrieving nodes and edges, and performing topological sort to detect cycles. It is part of the org.openmrs.util package and appears to be a core utility for graph-related operations within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A generic directed graph implementation with cycle detection and topological sorting capabilities.

classes.name: Graph.Edge
classes.description: Represents a directed edge between two nodes in the graph.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Adds a node to the graph.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.description: Adds an edge to the graph.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns the set of all nodes in the graph.

methods.name: getEdges
methods.description: Returns the set of all edges in the graph.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node matching the given element, or null if not found.

methods.name: getEdgesEndingWith
methods.description: Returns all edges ending with a specific node.

methods.name: topologicalSort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of the graph, throwing a CycleException if a cycle is detected.
